fixtures: controlComp('yan', true) only — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / yan (carry) / helm (fixed B3). Yan is Burst I, so a B2+B3 must be present for any Full Burst to occur at all; the control comp supplies both, making skill1's fullBurstEnter trigger non-vacuously exercised. The fixed B3 (helm) is kept rather than dropped because every assertion filters buffApply by stat AND the exact kit magnitude (21.55 / 2.77 / 1.33), so a teammate's same-stat buff cannot mask or manufacture a pass; keeping her also guarantees a second charge-weapon consumer so skill1's allies-vs-self discriminator is non-vacuous (self-scoping must visibly cost team damage). Six withPatchedOverride counterfactual runs (S1 burstCast re-key, S1 attackDamagePct re-stat, S1 self-scope, S2 fullBurstEnter re-key, S2 self-scope, burst nuke stripped) plus one base run = 7 hoisted 180s sims.
